options.name: capacity_tier
options.description: The aggregate's capacity tier for tiering cold data to object storage. If the value is NONE, the capacity_tier will not be set on aggregate creation.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The connector ID of the Cloud Manager Connector.

options.name: disk_size_size
options.description: The required size of the disks.

options.name: disk_size_unit
options.description: The disk size unit ['GB' or 'TB']. The default is 'TB'.

options.name: environment
options.description: The environment for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: home_node
options.description: The home node that the new aggregate should belong to.

options.name: iops
options.description: Provisioned IOPS. Needed only when providerVolumeType is "io1".

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the new aggregate.

options.name: number_of_disks
options.description: The required number of disks in the new aggregate.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: The refresh token for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_client_id
options.description: The service account secret client ID for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_secret_key
options.description: The service account secret key for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified aggregate should exist or not.

options.name: throughput
options.description: Unit is Mb/s. Valid range 125-1000. Required only when provider_volume_type is 'gp3'.

options.name: working_environment_id
options.description: The public ID of the working environment where the aggregate will be created.

options.name: working_environment_name
options.description: The working environment name where the aggregate will be created.
